name: U.S. Reports volumes 300–399 — Caselaw Access Project — 1910–1970 (part-0001)
description: 61926 historical CAP case records, selected by selected reporter volumes. Part of U.S. Reports volumes 300–399 — Caselaw Access Project; see the collection index for complete coverage. Every CAP case record in U.S. Reports volumes 300–399, preserving source jurisdiction, court labels, and decision dates, including four source dates earlier than the books' 1937–1970 period. This bounded historical reporter collection contains the earlier 347–349 pilot in full; installing both duplicates those records. It is not the complete U.S. Reports or federal collection. OCR may contain errors; inclusion does not establish current legal authority.
